----- components/Tombol.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Tombol". Requires Tailwind CSS v4 and theme.css (imports tokens.css).
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';

export type TombolProps = {
  label?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  icon?: "arrow-right" | "download" | "play";
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Tombol({ label = "Button", showIcon = true, icon = "arrow-right", className, style }: TombolProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`relative flex flex-row gap-[8px] items-center p-[12px_20px] bg-[color:var(--colors-brand)] rounded-[var(--radius-pill)] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto] w-[fit-content] ${className ?? ''}`.trimEnd()} style={style}>
      <div className="[font-family:var(--font-body)] font-[600] not-italic text-[15px] leading-[20px] text-[#FFFFFF] whitespace-pre box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto]">
        {label}
      </div>
      {showIcon && (
        <div className="box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_18px] w-[18px] h-[18px]">
          {icon === "arrow-right" && (
            <svg className="overflow-visible block" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 12h14" />
              <path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "download" && (
            <svg className="overflow-visible block" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M12 15V3" />
              <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4" />
              <path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "play" && (
            <svg className="overflow-visible block" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 5a2 2 0 0 1 3.008-1.728l11.997 6.998a2 2 0 0 1 .003 3.458l-12 7A2 2 0 0 1 5 19z" />
            </svg>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Tombol;

      <div className="relative flex flex-row items-center justify-center [background:linear-gradient(135deg,_var(--colors-brand)_0%,_#7C3AED_100%)] rounded-[12px] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_44px] h-[44px] w-[44px]">

// Generated by Lakar from component "Tombol". Requires Tailwind CSS v4 and theme.css (imports tokens.css).
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';

export type TombolProps = {
  label?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  icon?: "arrow-right" | "download" | "play";
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Tombol({ label = "Button", showIcon = true, icon = "arrow-right", className, style }: TombolProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`relative flex flex-row gap-[8px] items-center p-[12px_20px] bg-[color:var(--colors-brand)] rounded-[var(--radius-pill)] box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto] w-[fit-content] ${className ?? ''}`.trimEnd()} style={style}>
      <div className="[font-family:var(--font-body)] font-[600] not-italic text-[15px] leading-[20px] text-[#FFFFFF] whitespace-pre box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_auto]">
        {label}
      </div>
      {showIcon && (
        <div className="box-border m-[0] flex-[0_0_18px] w-[18px] h-[18px]">
          {icon === "arrow-right" && (
            <svg className="overflow-visible block" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
              <path d="M5 12h14" />
              <path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7" />
            </svg>
          )}
          {icon === "download" && (
            <svg className="overflow-visible block" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">

              <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4" />
              <path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5" />

            </svg>

      )}
    </div>
